---
name: Feature Request
about: Propose a new capability or improvement
title: "feat: <concise description>"
labels: [enhancement]
assignees: []
---

## Problem / Opportunity
What user or system problem does this address? Why now?

## Proposed Solution
High‑level summary (flow, data structures, interfaces). Include sequence or merkle impacts if relevant.

## Alternatives Considered
List any rejected approaches and why.

## Risks / Constraints
- Proof chain integrity impact?
- Performance / resource implications?
- Security considerations?
- Backwards compatibility?

## Dependencies
Related services, external libs, architectural prerequisites.

## Metrics / Observability
What new metrics, logs, or dashboards are needed?

## Testing Strategy
Unit / integration / e2e coverage plan.

## Definition of Done
Checklist of verifiable outcomes.

## Additional Context
Diagrams, prior issues, benchmarks, references.
